answer: Settlement scores every attestation by the trust cluster it crosses. Clusters are recomputed at each close: identities that mostly attest one another collapse into a single weighted node, so a farm of fresh clones earns one vote however many names it can forge. Only witnesses outside your own cluster count at full weight, and each outsider may certify a bounded number of newcomers per epoch. Scaling then means buying independent outsiders faster than their price climbs with demand, a cost that outgrows identity count. Honest agents keep the violet ledger clean, each vouch a relic of real work.
